response.original_title: {FAQ™Add Another Room} How Can I Add Another Room to My Virgin Voyages Booking?
response.overview: To add another room to an existing Virgin Voyages Cruise 1-866-254-7549 reservation, you must book a separate new stateroom and call Virgin Voyages Cruise customer service at +1-866-254-7549(US) or contact your travel agent to link the two bookings. Book a separate cabin: You cannot add a room to an existing reservation through the online website or mobile app. Book a new stateroom online or via phone. Contact Virgin Voyages Cruise at +1-866-254-7549(US) or your travel agent.
